options.description: One fieldset per category that has active options, in this order; each checkbox is labelled with the option's display name. No option is preselected.

captcha.production: Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget rendered with the site key from form-config
captcha.testMode: a checkbox labelled "I am not a robot (test mode)"; checked yields token test-pass, unchecked sends no token

confirmation.heading: Registration received
confirmation.text: Thank you, {firstName}. Your registration was received. A confirmation email is on its way to {email}.
confirmation.note: Shown only after a 201 response; the form is then hidden (BR-06)

errors.fieldError: text shown under the field, linked with aria-describedby; the field gets aria-invalid=true
errors.formError: role=alert region above the submit button for errors that belong to no field

messages.INVALID_CHARACTERS: This value contains characters that are not allowed.
messages.UNKNOWN_OPTION: One of the selected options is not available.
messages.INACTIVE_OPTION: One of the selected options is not available.
messages.DUPLICATE_OPTION: An option was selected more than once.
messages.CONSENT_REQUIRED: You must give this consent to register.
messages.CAPTCHA_FAILED: Please confirm that you are not a robot.
messages.NOT_ALLOWED: This field does not belong to the selected registration type.
messages.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: This email address is already registered. Please contact the organizers if you need to change your registration.
messages.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
messages.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Your registration could not be saved. Please try again later.
messages.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
